title: Coordinate GPU, RAM and CPU across Mana workloads
body:
## Summary

Closes #1380.

- Add one shared coordinator for RAM, VRAM and CPU leases, verified telemetry, residency, priorities, aging, cancellation and explicit CPU alternatives.
- Integrate chat/model loads, voice, embeddings/reranking, self-work, generated skills, Python analysis and disposable workspace tests.
- Reserve native model residency before startup; verify launcher ownership and recover surviving services after backend restart.
- Keep active sandbox tests running, pause background work at safe boundaries, and evict only idle backend-owned models.
- Retain reservations until owned processes actually exit; preserve failed-cleanup capacity instead of treating it as free.
- Protect streamed replies through body completion and serialize Fish device transfers with confirmed residency updates.
- Expose authenticated resource diagnostics and Mana's read-only chat inventory.

## Approved Policy

Background work retains 15% RAM headroom and leaves two logical processors outside its allocations. This is admission accounting, not CPU affinity. Missing/stale GPU telemetry retries briefly, then queues new GPU loads. CPU alternatives require fresh approval. Sandbox hard budgets, unrestricted-rerun approvals, gaming guards and local/cloud consent are unchanged.

## Verification

- Full local backend suite passed.
- Final focused model/coordinator integration run: 235 passed.
- Native launcher full suite: 1,484 passed, 28 skipped.
- Desktop tests: 78 passed.
- Live native sandbox/analysis/skill tests: 44 passed, one opt-in .NET fixture skipped locally (covered by Windows sandbox CI).
- Actual RTX 5080: GPU chat progressed while an AppContainer Node test stayed active; both completed; all owned model PIDs exited and all reservations released. Final VRAM free: 14,633 MiB before / 14,643 MiB after. System RAM varies with other processes, so exact equality is not asserted.
- Three consecutive clean review passes completed after the final changes; syntax checks and staged diff checks passed.
- Final follow-up: embedding CPU admission matches its explicit llama.cpp thread count; tool rounds restore their assistant adapter after interactive chat runs between rounds. Renewed three-pass review passed; additional chat/runtime tests: 57 passed.

## Boundaries

Telemetry currently targets the first NVIDIA GPU, matching Mana's existing single-GPU guard. Unknown per-process WDDM readings receive no credit. Estimates are not exact peak predictions or OS limits. GPT-SoVITS requires measured RAM/VRAM estimates; unlimited host prompt caches cannot be admitted. Failed cleanup remains visible for recovery rather than silently clearing reservations.

See `docs/resource-coordination.md` for the ownership, admission, cleanup and live-verification contract.
